author: toketrain
body:
===============================
1.5 update
-Added middle island (more pvp space, less space between sides)
-Fixed kits (gave defender iron pickaxe (eff. I), turned down power on sniper bow
-Added protective rails
-Added more detail
Thanks D00ZiE, kycrafft, MLGtino, and ivifetitaYT for the suggestions!

New pic
===============================

Hello! Today I've been finishing up my newest map. It's called Shift. It's a two team game, with 20 people on each team. There are kits as well, inspired by the map "Axis".

Kits:

- Rusher:

  •   Speed 1
  •   Iron Helmet
  •   Leather Boots
  •   Iron Sword
  •   Diamond Pickaxe (Eff. II)
  •   Apples (16)
  •   Golden Apples (1)
  •   Oak Log (64)

- Sniper:
  •   Chainmail Helmet
  •   Leather Chestplate
  •   Leather Boots
  •   Bow (Infinity I, Power I)
  •   Diamond Pickaxe
  •   Apples (16)
  •   Arrow
  •   Oak Log (64)

- Defender:
  •   Iron Helmet
  •   Leather Chestplate
  •   Chainmail Boots
  •   Stone Sword (Knockback I)
  •   Bow
  •   Apples (16)
  •   Arrows (32)
  •   Oak Log (64)
  •   Iron pickaxe (Eff. I)


The map has a few diamonds, plenty of iron, two monuments per team, and four towers per team.

When you first spawn, you start in the kit room. Upon selecting a kit you are teleported to your team's spawn, on the actual map.

The kit room may not look like much, but there are holographic words and such.


Mediafire map download with yml (version 1.5)

Imgur photos

Pastebin yml

Feedback would be awesome B)
